nodes.state: Fictional company Tidewell builds an AI agent that prepares and follows up dental insurance claims for independent practices. Maya Ortiz, CEO, ran billing for a 12-location dental group for six years. Dev Patel, CTO, spent four years on document-understanding models at a large cloud provider and has shipped two production ML systems. Both founders work full time. There is no sales hire yet.

questions.prompt: How complete is the founding team for this market?

Complete team, including proven sales leadership
Missing skills the company needs to build the product
